purpose: Generate high-resolution, vivid, breed-accurate dog images for PetStorie articles. Replace the existing placeholder JPG files while keeping the same filenames and article paths.
global_constraints: Photorealistic natural dog photography, high resolution, sharp focus, detailed fur texture, lively expression.
Accurate breed appearance and typical body shape. Avoid mixed-breed ambiguity.
No text, no watermark, no logo, no signature, no visible brand marks, no collar tag text.
Avoid distorted anatomy, extra legs, missing paws, unnatural eyes, plastic-looking fur, over-smoothed skin, cartoon style, illustration style, painterly style, blurry image, heavy filters.
Use natural light and realistic environments. Keep the dog clearly visible and not hidden by props, people, or deep shadows.
Output JPG files and overwrite the listed target paths only after visual quality review.
